title: T Dott Woo Was Reportedly Gunned Down In Front Of  His Home In Brooklyn
htmlContent:
Rapper Tdott Woo passed away on Tuesday evening [February 1, 2022]; the rapper was best featured in Pop Smoke and Fivio Foreign music videos. He was shot and killed in front of his home in Brooklyn, New York.

Tdot woo my heart, I will see you soon. I hate this… I wish I could've told you to come to Florida faster so you could've avoided this shit. I love you," said Twitter user Cedes.

"I will miss you every day and I will shake up every spot like we did… like you still here."

The Brooklyn rapper suffered a head injury and was pronounced dead shortly after. This story is currently developing, and at this time of this post, Fivio Foreign has yet to release a statement. The passing of Tdot Woo comes a day after Nax Blixxy, from a rival rap group called Foreignside, was shot in the head. However, Nas is still alive, but he is in critical condition. The reason for the attack is still unknown.

Nax Blixx and Tdott Woo's cases are both being investigated, but there have not been any arrests as of yet. We will keep you updated as the news comes in.
